q.en: An isolation amplifier has an input stage of gain 12 and an output stage of gain 8 with a 15 mV rms input. The output voltage is

q.en: Instrumentation amplifier of Fig. 14–53 (R1 = R2 = 100 kΩ, RG = 1.0 kΩ, R3 = R4 = R5 = R6 = 10 kΩ): voltage gains of A1 and A2.
q.vi: Mạch khuếch đại thiết bị Hình 14–53 (R1 = R2 = 100 kΩ, RG = 1,0 kΩ, R3 = R4 = R5 = R6 = 10 kΩ): độ lợi của A1 và A2.

sol.en: Each input stage is a noninverting amplifier sharing RG: Av(1) = Av(2) = 1 + R/RG = 1 + 100 kΩ/1.0 kΩ = 101 (book: 101).
sol.vi: Av(1) = Av(2) = 1 + 100 kΩ/1,0 kΩ = 101 cho mỗi tầng vào (sách: 101).

sol.en: Av = (1 + 2R/RG)(R5/R3) = (1 + 200 kΩ/1.0 kΩ)(10 kΩ/10 kΩ) = 201. (Consistent with Problem 3: 201 × 5 mV = 1.005 V.)

q.en: Vin1 = 5 mV, Vin2 = 10 mV and Vcm = 225 mV are applied to the amplifier of Figure 14–53. Find the output voltage.

sol.en: The common-mode part (225 mV) is rejected; only the difference is amplified: Vout = 201 × (10 − 5) mV = 1.005 V (book: 1.005 V).

q.en: An OTA with gm = 5000 μS has RL = 10 kΩ and Vin = 100 mV. Output current and output voltage?

sol.en: Iout = gm·Vin = 5000 μS × 100 mV = 500 μA; Vout = Iout·RL = 500 μA × 10 kΩ = 5 V (book: 500 μA, 5 V).
sol.vi: Iout = gm·Vin = 5000 μS × 100 mV = 500 μA; Vout = Iout·RL = 500 μA × 10 kΩ = 5 V (sách: 500 μA, 5 V).

q.en: The output voltage of an OTA with a load is 3.5 V, gm = 4000 μS and Vin = 100 mV. What is RL?

sol.en: Iout = 4000 μS × 100 mV = 400 μA; RL = Vout/Iout = 3.5 V / 400 μA = 8.75 kΩ.
sol.vi: Iout = 4000 μS × 100 mV = 400 μA; RL = Vout/Iout = 3,5 V / 400 μA = 8,75 kΩ.
